items.title: Customize your SQL Server to Aurora PostgreSQL conversion with AWS Transform
items.summary: Introduction In this blog post, we show how to review and customize the transformation plan in AWS Transform before you convert Microsoft SQL Server databases to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL (Aurora PostgreSQL). A database migration rarely stalls on the objects that convert cleanly. It stalls on the decisions. You decide whether MONEY carries four decimal places […]
